lines.en: Would you like to respond to this message?
What would you like to say?
: I don't think you're legally allowed to send me nudes of other people without their consent.
: Should I refrain from doing this in the future?
: No. I'm looking forward to the continuation of this series.
: Yesssss. More pictures of the wild Fukuyama in all of its buxom glory.
: Are you jerking off right now?
: Nope. Just admiring the view.
: Lame.
: Maybe if you got a little closer when you took the picture.
: I will remember that in the future ;D
: There is one glaring problem with this image.
: Oh? Do tell.
: Why do you have a towel on?
: Because I had already finished my shower, Sensei.
: It wouldn't be appropriate for me to just traipse around in the nude.
: But it was appropriate to take a nude picture of Futaba without her consent?
: Oh, wow. I didn't even realize she was in the picture.
: I was just trying to take a cute selfie.
: You'd be cuter without clothes on.
: Oh yeah? ;D
: I'll keep that in mind for my next selfie.
: Excellent research photo, Nodoka.
: I camped out nine hours for this shot.
: You camped out in the shower for nine hours?
: I really like showers.
: I also really like breasts.
: I regret nothing.
: Do you have any more?
: Not at the moment. But I'm currently waiting outside of her normal camping grounds for the chance to take another.
: I shall keep you in the loop.
: Oh shit! Gotta go!
: The Fukuyama approaches!
